set.body: Replace closure-only worker assumptions with an explicit source-descriptor protocol that distinguishes coordinator-readable, reopenable read-only, and externally shared sources. Worker attachment must validate the same stable revision, close only owned handles, and fail before dispatch when safe reopening is unavailable. Completion requires matrix/local, file-backed, stale-revision, and cleanup tests.
set.title: Define worker-reopenable and shared relation source descriptors
